hand: Shadow Hand (30-DoF: 24-DoF hand + 6-DoF floating wrist) in simulation; 16-DoF Allegro hand + 6-DoF Ability Hand (mismatched, hardware-availability artifact) in real-world experiments
arm: Kinova Gen3, 7-DoF (real-world); floating 6-DoF wrist bases in simulation
success_criterion: task-specific, e.g. Block in cup: block-to-cup-center distance < 0.035 m; Stack: cup-to-cup distance < 0.02 m; Bottle cap: cap displaced 0.05 m; Switch: button rotated 0.3585 rad
headline_metric: interaction-phase success rate vs. ablations, mean over 5 seeds (Table 1)
headline_value: AsymDex: Block in cup 0.7701, Stack 0.8392, Bottle cap 0.6295, Switch 0.6700 (Table 1), vs. best ablation baseline reaching at most 0.6560 (Rel-w/o-Asym, Stack)
paper_code_mismatch: Code contains a GraspAndPlace-task reward variant (AllegroHandDualArmGraspAndPlaceAsymDex.py) with exponential hand-distance and block-alignment terms not one of the four BiDexHands tasks described in the paper body.
